scientific_conclusion: Dense c_proj phase motion is overwhelmingly transport of the 3072-wide post-GELU input frame. Output-side transport alone is weak; independent transport on both sides nearly saturates endpoint recovery.

interpretation.hyperconnection: not selected: residual-output transport is only 12.74% and prior scalar/dynamic residual gates were practical ties
interpretation.selected_geometry: global orthogonal transport of the 3072-wide post-GELU frame with optional smaller output-frame correction
interpretation.deployable_family: learned-angle global butterfly/Givens flow with fixed connectivity; no learned dense basis and no LoRA
interpretation.required_next_gate: fit the fixed-connectivity nonlinear flow to dense phase endpoints and measure recovery relative to the 85.72% right-orbit oracle before any training run
